EXECUTIVE APARMTENT - AMAZING CENTRAL LOCATION

                    ~ OFFERS OVER £235,000-£250,00~

Located right in the heart of Central Milton Keynes, this impressive 676 sq ft executive apartment at Tower Gate enjoys a prime position on Averbury Boulevard, just a fiveminute walk from John Lewis and the extensive range of retail, dining and leisure amenities the city centre has to offer.
The apartment comprises two wellproportioned double bedrooms and is finished to a high standard throughout. The stylish, contemporary kitchen features builtin appliances and opens seamlessly into the bright openplan living area, creating an ideal space for both relaxing and entertaining.
Further benefits include parking, lift access within the building and a secure, wellmaintained communal environment. Offered chain free, this wellpresented flat is ideally suited to professionals, investors or those seeking modern citycentre living with excellent transport links close by.

Please note that an AML fee is chargeable to the buyer once an offer is accepted to cover the cost of carrying out the required identity and anti-money laundering checks. Once these checks have been completed, the fee cannot be refunded, even if the property purchase does not go ahead.
